podcast.body: This song exemplifies David Byrne's distinctive, quirky singing voice and his equally unusual stage presence at the time, characterized by shifty and jerky movements. "The talking heads with life during wartime featuring David Byrne, and not only is his singing voice quirky, so was his stage image at the time."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
